title: semantic-model.lock.json — human-approved pinned classifier
description: Written by a HUMAN at the Task 5 selection gate after reviewing measured benchmark results. Code never generates this file. runtime/classifier.py load_lock() enforces the same constraints at runtime; this schema exists so the lock can also be validated by generic tooling.

executable_path.description: Absolute path to the classifier executable. Relative paths are rejected.

model_path.description: Absolute path to the model artifact. Relative paths are rejected.

corpus_sha256.description: Digest of the corpus the approved benchmark ran on. eval_runtime_injection.py --verify recomputes and compares.

confidence_floor.description: Below this, any label becomes UNRESOLVED. Measured at the benchmark, recorded here, never tuned live.
